$comment: F5/Q2 - the ONE canonical schedule action table. Derived from the real backend authority (backend/jarvis_schedule.py: Scheduler.act's decision table, the Kind registry, and Wave D-1's propose_ready/suggest_done for ready_for_review) and the words both apps already share. Surfaces (HUD jarvis_hud.html, coming-up.js, Schedule.kt) MUST match this table; tools/check_schedule_actions.py reports each surface, and contract/README.md says who still has to consume it. Data only: no code, no words that are not user-facing below. The shared desktop table is jarvis-desktop/src/hud-actions.js (coherence #729): the HUD's fallback and the Brain consume it; the shared table section below is the only desktop source of truth the checker reads.
owner: prompt-wiring (contract + checker only; surfaces are owned by their PRs)

authority.act: Scheduler.act (one of pause, resume, delete, done, add_time, snooze; refusals in plain words)
authority.kinds: Kind registry (register_kind) - S.KINDS after KIND_MODULES load, plus jarvis_goals.KIND = goal_checkin when Goals registers it
authority.states: LISTED = active, paused, waiting; fired rows are shown under 'Just went off'; D-1 adds the ready_for_review marker to a to-do
authority.snooze: S.SNOOZABLE = timer, alarm, reminder; S.SNOOZE_DEFAULT seconds

consumers.hud: jarvis-desktop/src/jarvis_hud.html imports actionsFor (window.__hudActionsFor) and keeps a browser-served fallback
consumers.coming_up: jarvis-desktop/src/coming-up.js imports ACTION_LABELS, WENT_OFF_ACTIONS and actionNames

shared.why: one module, no DOM, no dependency; the phone cannot import it yet (Session B / Q2), so its hand-written table stays the pending surface

rules.add_time: only a TIMER (S.act: 'Time can only be added to a timer.'); +5 minutes is the one amount both apps offer
rules.done: only a TO-DO (S.act: 'Only a to-do item can be marked done.')
rules.pause: an ACTIVE job of a kind that has a time of its own (never a to-do; never a Kind.ends kind such as nexttime)
rules.snooze: only a fired timer/alarm/reminder (S.SNOOZABLE), under 'Just went off', for 10 minutes
rules.delete: every listed state, and a fired entry too (DEF-008)
rules.order: the array order below IS the button order; surfaces draw it left to right
rules.never: no action ever means 'all', 'clear everything' or a bulk form

goal_checkin.registered_by: jarvis_goals.KIND (Goals registers it when its module loads; not in jarvis_schedule.KIND_MODULES)
goal_checkin.surface_note: Goals owns this kind (jarvis_goals.KIND); it is registered only with Goals' own module, which is not in jarvis_schedule.KIND_MODULES. The phone already draws it with NO buttons; the desktop surfaces do not special-case it yet, so it is not in the cross-surface comparison until a Goals/HUD PR adds the special case. The contract entry (no actions) is what that PR must draw.

ready_for_review.said: Ready for your review - only you can mark it done.
ready_for_review.authority: Wave D-1 (#722): Scheduler.propose_ready/suggest_done set a marker only; act('done') is still the ONLY way to mark it done, and the view carries done=false
ready_for_review.added_by: D-1 #722, merged to main as 478c934f0 on 2026-10-22. The backend marker is on main; the HUD/Brain/Phone PRs that surface it have one table to draw.
ready_for_review.surface_note: Wave D-1's backend marker is merged (#722 / 478c934f0); no desktop or phone surface draws it yet. The contract entry is the table they will draw; its absence is reported as a note, not as a surface difference, until a marker PR lands.

surface_cases.$comment: The (kind, state, went_off) cases every surface is compared on; not every combination exists in the product, only the reachable ones.

hud.table: browser-served fallbackActionsFor + import of ./hud-actions.js (window.__hudActionsFor); tests/hud.mjs proves the two agree
hud.owner: Coherence Fix Slice (Session A) - consumed in #729
hud.reason: reads the shared hud-actions.js table; the browser-served fallback table matches the contract on every case

coming_up.table: imports ACTION_LABELS / WENT_OFF_ACTIONS / actionNames from ./hud-actions.js; actionsOf delegates, labelOf reads the shared label
coming_up.owner: Coherence Fix Slice (Session A) - consumed in #729
coming_up.reason: a pure consumer of the shared hud-actions.js table; its own words and action list both come from it

phone.reason: Schedule.kt offers add_time in ACTIONS, actionsOf and labelOf with the contract's own label, and all 29 shared cases match; the Q2/F5 phone PR consumed the contract.
